learning_outcomes.text: Assimilates the scientific, technological, and economic criteria for developing components and design techniques for precision equipment.
Knows the different types of measurement equipment and techniques, and selects the most appropriate for each need.
Knows and applies methodologies for verifying production systems.
Knows predictive maintenance techniques and their applications.

syllabus_topics: Industrial vision. Non-contact measurement and reverse engineering
Predictive maintenance techniques and their applications
Calibration, techniques, and equipment in dimensional metrology
assessment_rules: Students can opt for gradual assessment, comprising a written test (30% of the final grade, requiring a score above 4.0 to average) and a set of assignments (implied 70%). Failure to pass a gradual assessment component or a desire to improve the grade allows the student to take a global assessment. This global assessment is an exam covering both blocks with the same point distribution and minimum marks as the gradual assessment. Academic fraud during tests results in a failing grade for that test and potential disciplinary action.
